model.name: openai/gpt-6-luna
model.about: OpenAI: GPT-6 Luna, through OpenRouter at $0.1 in and $0.5 out per million tokens.

answers.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS active_customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR IS TRUE
  AND IS_ACTV IS TRUE;

WITH latest_august_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(dt.cal_dt) AS cal_dt
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt
    WHERE dt.cal_dt >= DATE '2025-08-01'
      AND dt.cal_dt < DATE '2025-09-01'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dlq.cust_k) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D AS dlq
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt
  ON dt.dt_k = dlq.bus_dt_k
JOIN latest_august_date AS lad
  ON dt.cal_dt = lad.cal_dt
WHERE dlq.dflt_flg IS TRUE;

SELECT
    ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ACCT_NBR_HSH) AS accounts_opened
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE OPND_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND OPND_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT
    br.CTY_NM AS branch_city,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN AS txn
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR AS br
    ON txn.BR_K = br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt
    ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND dt.CAL_DT < DATE '2025-04-01'
GROUP BY br.CTY_NM
ORDER BY br.CTY_NM;

SELECT
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH branch_counts AS (
    SELECT
        br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
        br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
        br.BR_K,
        COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN AS txn
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR AS br
        ON txn.BR_K = br.BR_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt
        ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND dt.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
    GROUP BY br.RGN_CD1, br.DSPLY_NM, br.BR_K
), ranked AS (
    SELECT
        region_code,
        branch_name,
        atm_transaction_count,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY region_code
            ORDER BY atm_transaction_count DESC
        ) AS region_rank
    FROM branch_counts
)
SELECT
    region_code,
    branch_name,
    atm_transaction_count
FROM ranked
WHERE region_rank = 1
ORDER BY region_code, branch_name;

WITH wire_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS w
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
      ON d.DT_K = w.BUS_DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND d.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
      AND CUST_K IS NOT NULL
), atm_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN AS a
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
      ON d.DT_K = a.BUS_DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND d.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
      AND CUST_K IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM wire_customers AS w
JOIN atm_customers AS a USING (CUST_K);

SELECT
    cust_k,
    bus_id,
    cty_nm,
    cust_sgmnt_cd1 AS current_customer_segment,
    'AFFLUENT'::varchar(50) AS proposed_customer_segment
FROM bank_dwh.d_cust
WHERE cty_nm = 'Cluj-Napoca'
  AND is_curr IS TRUE;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS active_customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR IS TRUE
  AND IS_ACTV IS TRUE;

SELECT
    ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS accounts_opened
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE IS_CURR IS TRUE
  AND OPND_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND OPND_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR IS TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CUST_K) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST AS c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN AS t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
      ON d.DT_K = t.BUS_DT_K
    WHERE t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
      AND d.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND d.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
);

SELECT
    100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED')
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS declined_authorizations_pct
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH
WHERE ATHRZ_AT >= TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00'
  AND ATHRZ_AT <  TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
  ON d.DT_K = w.BUS_DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST AS c
  ON c.CUST_K = w.CUST_K
 AND d.CAL_DT >= c.EFF_FRM_DT
 AND (c.EFF_TO_DT IS NULL OR d.CAL_DT < c.EFF_TO_DT)
WHERE d.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND d.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND w.IS_CRSS_BRDR IS TRUE
  AND c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME';

WITH branch_atm_counts AS (
    SELECT
        br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
        br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
        COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN AS txn
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR AS br
        ON txn.BR_K = br.BR_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt
        ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND dt.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
    GROUP BY br.RGN_CD1, br.DSPLY_NM
), ranked AS (
    SELECT
        region_code,
        branch_name,
        atm_transaction_count,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY region_code
            ORDER BY atm_transaction_count DESC
        ) AS region_rank
    FROM branch_atm_counts
)
SELECT
    region_code,
    branch_name,
    atm_transaction_count
FROM ranked
WHERE region_rank = 1
ORDER BY region_code, branch_name;

WITH wire_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT w.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS w
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
      ON d.DT_K = w.BUS_DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND d.CAL_DT <  DATE '2026-01-01'
      AND w.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
),
atm_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN AS a
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
      ON d.DT_K = a.BUS_DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND d.CAL_DT <  DATE '2026-01-01'
      AND a.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM wire_customers AS w
JOIN atm_customers AS a
  ON a.CUST_K = w.CUST_K;

SELECT DISTINCT DSPLY_NM AS branch_name
FROM bank_dwh.D_BR
WHERE DSPLY_NM IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY branch_name;

SELECT
    CUST_K,
    BUS_ID,
    CTY_NM,
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS current_customer_segment,
    'AFFLUENT'::VARCHAR(50) AS requested_customer_segment
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE CTY_NM = 'Cluj-Napoca';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS active_customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR IS TRUE
  AND IS_ACTV IS TRUE;

SELECT
    b.BR_K AS branch_key,
    b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
    ON d.DT_K = f.BUS_DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR AS b
    ON b.BR_K = f.BR_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND d.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY b.BR_K, b.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY b.DSPLY_NM, b.BR_K;

SELECT
    c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
    COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG AS c
    ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND d.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC, complaint_category;

SELECT
    ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ACCT_NBR_HSH) AS accounts_opened
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE OPND_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND OPND_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH escalated_by_category AS (
    SELECT
        f.cmplt_ctg_k,
        COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_count
    FROM bank_dwh.f_cmplt AS f
    JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt AS dt
      ON dt.dt_k = f.bus_dt_k
    WHERE dt.cal_dt >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND dt.cal_dt < DATE '2026-01-01'
      AND f.is_esclt IS TRUE
    GROUP BY f.cmplt_ctg_k
)
SELECT
    c.dsply_nm AS complaint_category_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(e.escalated_complaint_count), 0) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.d_cmplt_ctg AS c
LEFT JOIN escalated_by_category AS e
  ON e.cmplt_ctg_k = c.cmplt_ctg_k
GROUP BY c.dsply_nm
ORDER BY c.dsply_nm;

WITH wire_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT w.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS w
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON d.DT_K = w.BUS_DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND d.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
      AND w.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
),
atm_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN AS a
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON d.DT_K = a.BUS_DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND d.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
      AND a.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customer_count
FROM wire_customers AS w
JOIN atm_customers AS a ON a.CUST_K = w.CUST_K;

UPDATE bank_dwh.D_CUST
SET CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'AFFLUENT'
WHERE CTY_NM = 'Cluj-Napoca'
  AND IS_CURR IS TRUE;
